data.long_meaning: Derived from the Sanskrit word आत्थिक (Athitik), meaning 'Lord' or 'Presence'. In Hindu mythology, Athik is a name of Lord Shiva, symbolizing power, strength, and protection. The name Athik carries the meaning “Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Athik usually hope their child will grow to embody lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
